title: statusline r2 AIE: wall-clock budget has no verification instrument
description: Round: statusline amendment cold round 2. Lens: ai-engineer (validator: platform-engineer). Owner: SO session. Defect: the declared wall-clock budget (number at 1c) names no criterion, gate, or fixture that checks a render stays within it — every other deferred number in the contract names its instrument (mutation floor gate, token budget CI gate); byte-identity does not bound latency. Citations verified: contract:160, :185, :170. Proposed: resolved-candidate. Failure: cheap-by-contract unfalsifiable; event-frequency-multiplied latency regression uncaught.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in working tree. Status detection criterion now carries the timing instrument: each fixture's segment render completes within the declared wall-clock budget; the number arrives with 1c data authoring and the check ships with it — instrument, not just existence. Revision: Status detection criterion.
